_comment: §2.5 declared round-trip subset. The CLEAN set must match exactly (setMustMatchExactly): a form expected clean that is not is a fail, and an escape that comes out clean is also a fail. Byte-equality with the ORIGINAL is deliberately NOT required — the corpus carries defects. triageOnly forms are decompiled, reported uninspectable, and never contribute to pass/fail. inline-editable-table is the legacy seed's synthesised envelope (git-mv'd out of examples in WP-1). WP-6 raised the clean set from 4 to 7: the datatable column lift (DEC-7306) and the action-intent grammar (openDialog argIgnore, closeDialog/confirm/startEdit/cancelEdit, D-111) cleared employee-table, employee-create and rs-table. The four forms still in triageOnly escape ONLY on the three container node-types the compiler does not yet emit (sectionSeparator, collapsiblePanel->panel, tabs), tracked in BL-024; lifting those is WP-6's remaining path to all-12.
